description: This PHP script generates a line graph using the jpgraph library. It processes request parameters to construct data series, configure graph dimensions, titles, colors, and other visual properties, and outputs the resulting graph image.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: A class from the jpgraph library used to create and configure graphs.

classes.name: LinePlot
classes.description: A class from the jpgraph library used to create line plots for the graph.

methods.name: SetMarginColor
methods.description: Sets the margin color of the graph.

methods.name: SetScale
methods.description: Sets the scale type for the axes.

methods.name: SetMargin
methods.description: Sets the margins around the graph.

methods.name: tabtitle->Set
methods.description: Sets the title of the graph tab.

methods.name: tabtitle->SetFont
methods.description: Sets the font style for the tab title.

methods.name: yaxis->HideZeroLabel
methods.description: Hides the zero label on the Y-axis.

methods.name: xgrid->Show
methods.description: Displays the grid lines along the X-axis.

methods.name: LinePlot->SetColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the line plot.

methods.name: LinePlot->SetLegend
methods.description: Sets the legend label for the line plot.

methods.name: xaxis->SetTickLabels
methods.description: Sets labels on the X-axis ticks.
